per_window.ps-ns: dynamic_in_window at the termini only. In free NRC (pH 6.5, phosphate) 15N R1/R2/NOE with ModelFree gives uniformly high S2 from the first N-cap helix through the last C-cap helix, both recognition loops included (R17306-J1, measured_not_detected; S2 about 0.75-0.95 read from Figure 4B, residues 12-97), while the terminal segments, about 8-11 and 98-103, have low S2 (J2, r1). Field and temperature of the relaxation set and the per-residue table (S1) were not available.
per_window.us-ms: search_insufficient (J4). No dispersion, CEST, R1rho or missing-peak assignment exists in the rows, and the method searches used the wrong species alias.
per_window.slower_than_ms: search_insufficient (J5). The paper's GdnHCl unfolding is equilibrium CD at pH 8.0, 20 °C without a rate, so it gives no slower-than-ms judgment.
per_window.undetermined: The pH 6.5 choice is explained tentatively by reduced exchange broadening of labile amide protons, a solvent-exchange reading with no residues or rate (J3, r3). Not judged: RDC restraints and the 20-model 2L6B ensemble (r2), which define helix orientations and do not represent measured populations or a second state.

protein_summary.wt_apo_answer: Not measured: for free designed NRC (the entry sequence, pH 6.5, 25 mM phosphate) no row measures µs-ms exchange; the only dynamics data are 15N R1/R2/NOE model-free order parameters, which are high from the first N-cap helix through the last C-cap helix (about 12-97, recognition loops included) and low only at the termini.
questions_for_gina: The input card gives UniProt N1S0H6 (a Fusarium ankyrin fragment) and a fungal species, but the entry is the designed NRC of Aksel et al. 2011 (BMRB 17306, PDB 2L6B); should the card be corrected before the searches are rerun?
Does the RelaxDB 17306 set include Rex terms or the relaxation field and temperature from Table S1, which we could not retrieve?
protein_summary.buffer_note: All NRC NMR samples are in 25 mM sodium phosphate, 25 mM NaCl, pH 6.5; the paper shows no phosphate binding, so no row is marked as a buffer artefact. Figure 4B per-residue S2 values and residue positions are read from the bar chart (plus or minus one residue). The NMR construct carries a C-terminal His6 tag beyond the 109-residue entry sequence. Method searches for this entry used the erroneous fungal species name, so every zero-hit class is search_insufficient rather than not_measured.
